guide.title: VIRTUAL_AUDIO_SETUP

steps: Download VB-Cable from the official VB-Audio website and unzip it.
Right-click VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe → Run as administrator → Install Driver. Restart your computer.
In Evoice → Voice Changer → LIVE, pick “CABLE Input (VB-Audio)” as Output, then press START.
In Discord / OBS / Zoom, choose “CABLE Output (VB-Audio)” as your microphone.
To hear yourself, enable “Listen to this device” for CABLE Output in Windows Sound settings.
Download BlackHole 2ch from the official Existential Audio website and run the installer.
Open Evoice → Voice Changer → LIVE, pick “BlackHole 2ch” as Output, then press START.
In Discord / OBS / Zoom, choose “BlackHole 2ch” as your microphone.
To hear yourself too, create a Multi-Output Device in Audio MIDI Setup with your speakers + BlackHole.

guide.note: Evoice does not install audio drivers itself. Links open the developers' official pages.

runtime.title: First-time setup
runtime.intro: Evoice needs to install its AI runtime (Python + PyTorch + engine libraries). This happens once; everything lives in the app's data folder and doesn't touch any other Python on this computer. Next you'll pick which models to download.
runtime.cpuBody: The app still works on CPU but slowly, and live voice changing won't be available. If you have an NVIDIA GPU, update its driver and reopen the app.
runtime.cpuBodyMac: Intel Macs have no GPU build of PyTorch, so the app runs on the CPU: speech generation and vocal separation are much slower than on Apple Silicon, and live voice changing and voice training may not keep up.
runtime.hint: This can take 5–20 minutes depending on your connection. If interrupted, Retry resumes from what was already downloaded.
runtime.failedHint: Check your internet connection and free disk space, then Retry; downloaded parts are kept.
